_comment: Private ICSE/ISC and IB schools in Bihar, Jharkhand and Haryana that are not in the CBSE SARAS directory. Every value is taken from the page in source_url (read 2026-10-25); anything a page does not state is left out and shows as 'Not available'. CBSE private schools in these states come from the SARAS pipeline instead. Import with POST /api/v1/admin/import/json (VALIDATE_ONLY first).

schools.name: Bishop Westcott Boys' School, Namkum
schools.description: Founded in 1927; the Bishop Westcott Schools were founded by the Right Rev. Dr. Foss Westcott, Bishop of Chotanagpur. The school's website publishes its ICSE (Class X) and ISC (Class XII) results and describes a boarding section of three dormitory-style hostels and school transport across Ranchi.

schools.name: Loreto Convent, Doranda
schools.description: Opened by the Loreto Sisters in February 1943 (Mother Leila Maguire). The school's website describes it as an English-medium ICSE school and lists ISC toppers.

schools.name: Loyola School, Jamshedpur
schools.managing_body: Fathers of the Society of Jesus (Jesuits)
schools.address_line: Beldih Triangle, Circuit House Area, Bistupur
schools.description: A CISCE school in the 10+2 format with higher secondary streams in Arts, Science and Commerce, run by the Jesuits (founded 1947, as stated on the school's website).

schools.name: St. Xavier's High School, Patna
schools.description: Run by the Jesuit Fathers and Brothers with lay staff. The school's website links to both the ICSE and BSEB websites and lists a BSEB book list for Class XII, so the board is not recorded here until the school states it.

schools.name: The Shri Ram School, Aravali
schools.description: Established in 2000. A co-educational day school following the CISCE curriculum from Pravesh Vatika (nursery) to Grade 12, with ICSE in Grades 9-10 and ISC in Grades 11-12.

schools.name: Pathways World School, Gurugram
schools.description: Launched in 2003; the school describes itself as the first IB school in North India, offering the IB Early Years, Primary Years (PYP), Middle Years (MYP) and Diploma (DP) programmes, with day school and weekly, fortnight and term boarding. General enquiries +91 124 4513000; admissions +91 9818666677 (headadmissions.pws@pathways.in).
